note: An objective is a fact about the world, not a script. The engine advances it from events; the text is the giver's.

quests.name: The True Word
quests.description: Find what the Vault really says, then answer at the Shrine.

objectives.text: Answer the true word at the Shrine

quests.complete: The shrine accepts the true word.

quests.name: The Vault Guardian
quests.description: The stone figure in the Vault has begun to move. Put it back to rest.
quests.complete: The guardian returns to stone.

quests.name: A Curled Scroll
quests.description: A scroll has been left in the Corridor. Bring it into the light.
quests.complete: The scroll is yours.

quests.name: Bread for the Shop
quests.description: Bring a loaf from the Cell to the shopkeeper in the Storeroom.

objectives.text: Deliver a loaf to the shopkeeper

quests.complete: The shopkeeper takes the loaf.

quests.name: The Boar at the Edge
quests.description: A boar has been rooting at the forest edge. Drive it off.
quests.complete: The forest edge is quiet again.

quests.name: The Well Key
quests.description: A brass key is lost in the old well. Bring it back.
quests.complete: The key is safe.

quests.name: The Crypt Ghoul
quests.description: Something has been feeding in the crypt. End it.
quests.complete: The crypt is still.

quests.name: The Smuggler's Cache
quests.description: A smuggler keeps a chest under the Cell. Find the cache and end the trade.
quests.complete: The cache is quiet.

quests.name: The Lighthouse Lens
quests.description: The lighthouse keeper has a brass telescope. Bring it back to the docks.
quests.complete: The docks have their glass.

quests.name: A Message for the Spellwright
quests.description: A folded note waits on the Lantern Stair. Take it to the spellwright in the Arcade.

objectives.text: Deliver the note to the spellwright

quests.complete: The spellwright reads the note and nods.

quests.name: The Apprentice's Charm
quests.description: The apprentice lost a charm by the fountain in the Familiar Yard.
quests.complete: The charm is warm in your hand.

quests.name: The High Walk
quests.description: The owl says the High Walk sees what the arcade hides. Climb to it, and deal with the rat that has been stealing from the perches.
quests.complete: The owl blinks once, slowly.

quests.name: The Guild's Ledger
quests.description: The archmage needs the spell scroll from the Spellwright back in the guild ledger.

objectives.text: Carry the spell scroll to the archmage

quests.complete: The archmage enters the scroll in the ledger.

quests.name: What the Mirror Keeps
quests.description: The owl says the High Walk hides a stair of water. Find the Mirror Pool and bring back a shard.
quests.complete: The shard is cold and your reflection is still missing.

quests.name: The Wardstone
quests.description: Beyond the pool, a warden keeps a key to a door with no handle.
quests.complete: The warden falls. The key is warm.

quests.name: The Drowned Ledger
quests.description: A drowned clerk keeps a page the guild wants. Find it in the Drowned Library.
quests.complete: The page is wet, but the names are still legible.

quests.name: Three Parts of a Sigil
quests.description: Three black discs are scattered through the Undervault. The archmage wants them together.
quests.complete: The three discs fit together. The eye opens.

quests.name: The Sigil Trial
quests.description: The three sigils can be gathered again each cycle. The archmage uses them to test the wards.
quests.complete: The archmage fits the sigils into the ward and hands them back for the next cycle.

quests.name: The Mirror Ledger
quests.description: The archmage wants a shard of the Mirror Pool for the guild ledger.
quests.complete: The archmage sets the shard in the ledger and the page goes dark.

quests.name: The Warden's Debt
quests.description: The warden in the Wardstone chamber still owes the guild a key. Collect it.
quests.complete: The archmage adds the key to a ring of identical keys.

quests.name: The Cistern Key
quests.description: A bone key waits in the Bone Archive beyond the drowned market. The owl wants it.
quests.complete: The bone key is warm.

quests.name: The Black Choir
quests.description: A great moth keeps a black bell above the choir altar.
quests.complete: The bell rings without a clapper.

quests.name: The Sealed Reliquary
quests.description: The reliquary keeper carries a lens that sees the quiet door.
quests.complete: The lens shows a door with no handle.

quests.name: The Last Lantern
quests.description: The last keeper has the last lantern. Bring it to the archmage.
quests.complete: The archmage sets the last lantern beside the orrery.

quests.name: The Choir Bell
quests.description: A black bell hangs above the choir moth. The archmage wants it for the guild's collection.
quests.complete: The archmage hangs the black bell beside the ledger.

quests.name: The Reliquary Lens
quests.description: The reliquary keeper holds a lens that sees the quiet door. The archmage wants it studied.
quests.complete: The archmage looks through the lens and does not blink.

quests.name: Beyond the Quiet Door
quests.description: The quiet door remembers the last lantern. Go through, reach the first flame, and bring back a coal.
quests.complete: The last keeper turns the coal in their fingers and smiles.

quests.name: The Cinder Hound
quests.description: A cinder hound has been hunting the slag gardens. The forge master wants its fang.
quests.complete: The forge master sets the fang on the anvil and nods.

quests.name: The Ash Key
quests.description: A key hangs above the ember chapel altar. The forge master says the chest in the vault will open for it.
quests.complete: The forge master looks at the key and says nothing.

quests.name: The Ember Lantern
quests.description: Bring the last keeper an ember lantern and a coal from the first flame.
quests.complete: The last keeper hangs the ember lantern beside the last lantern. The room holds two lights now.

quests.name: The Ember Warden
quests.description: The guild wants the coal guarded by the ember warden at the first flame.
quests.complete: The archmage sets the coal in a bowl of black glass. It does not stop burning.

quests.name: The Wisp Glass
quests.description: A fen wisp carries a shard of cold green glass. The heron keeper wants it for the fen.

objectives.text: Carry a piece of wisp glass

quests.complete: The heron keeper turns the glass until it catches a light that is not there.

quests.name: The Bog Hound
quests.description: A bog hound has been hunting the drowned orchard. The heron keeper wants its fang.
quests.complete: The heron keeper sets the fang among the reeds.

quests.name: The Old Beacon
quests.description: A green key hangs in the old beacon. The heron keeper says the fen vault will open for it.
quests.complete: The heron keeper looks at the key and nods once.

quests.name: The Green Heart
quests.description: The fen vault holds a green seed. Bring it to the green heart.
quests.complete: The heron keeper plants the seed beside the root. The room grows warmer.

quests.name: The Fen Wisp
quests.description: The guild wants a piece of wisp glass from the Hollow Fen.

objectives.text: Carry a piece of wisp glass

quests.complete: The archmage sets the glass in a bowl of water. It does not sink.

quests.name: The Brine Crab
quests.description: A brine crab guards the hall. The hermit wants its pearl.
quests.complete: The hermit sets the pearl in a bowl of brine.

quests.name: The Salt Heart
quests.description: The salt wraith guards the heart. Bring the hermit a shard.
quests.complete: The hermit holds the shard to the light and does not blink.

quests.name: First Steps
quests.description: A short tour for a new arrival: stand in the Atrium, then walk north into the Corridor.
quests.complete: The bard nods. The first step is always the same.

quests.name: The Salt Ward
quests.description: The salt wraith guards the heart. Bring the hermit a shard and wear the ward it makes.
quests.complete: The hermit presses the salt ward into your hand. It is cold and steady.

quests.name: The Deep Fen
quests.description: The heron keeper wants a wisp glass from the deepest fen and a look at the green heart.

objectives.text: Carry a piece of wisp glass

quests.complete: The heron keeper ties the charm around your neck. The reeds go still.

quests.name: The Moon Hare
quests.description: A moon hare carries a silver petal. The owl wants it for the well.
quests.complete: The owl sets the petal on the well and it floats.

quests.name: The Moonwell
quests.description: Draw water from the moonwell and open the pale chest.
quests.complete: The owl drinks and its eyes grow brighter.

quests.name: The Moon Stag
quests.description: The moon stag guards the throne. Bring the owl its antler.
quests.complete: The owl sets the antler beside the well. The moon in the water turns.

quests.name: The Eclipse Stair
quests.description: The herald will open the Eclipse Court to anyone who has faced the moon stag. Bring the key the sundial knight guards.
quests.complete: The herald takes the key and sets it in the stair. The way north opens.

quests.name: The Mirror Vault
quests.description: The mirror vault holds a crown of dawn. Open the black chest and bring the crown back to the herald's stair.
quests.complete: The herald sets the crown on the stair. The mirrors in the vault go dark.

quests.name: The Throne of Ash
quests.description: The eclipse regent holds the sigil that keeps the court closed. Take it from the throne of ash.
quests.complete: The herald closes the regent's eye. The dawn gate opens behind the throne.

quests.name: The Clerk's Errand
quests.description: A wax seal from the rat warren is missing from the ledger. Bring it back; the clerk finds another every cycle.

objectives.text: Deliver a clerk's seal to the guild clerk

quests.complete: The clerk presses the seal into the ledger and hands you a fresh page. The errand will return.

quests.name: A Word in the Hall
quests.description: The bard wants both versions of the same rumor. Talk to the market woman and the guild clerk.
quests.complete: The two stories do not agree. The bard writes both down.

quests.name: The Garden Remembers
quests.description: The rememberer wants a word learned from the guild clerk and carried to the shrine. Then visit the garden and let it hear you.

objectives.text: Learn the ledger word from the guild clerk
Recall the ledger word at the shrine

quests.complete: The rememberer takes the rose and sets it in the bed. The garden remembers with you.

quests.name: The Moon in the Garden
quests.description: The silver owl keeps the crescent word. Learn it, recall it at the shrine, and bring the garden its moon seed.

objectives.text: Learn the crescent word from the silver owl
Recall the crescent word at the shrine

quests.complete: The rememberer plants the moon seed. A white crescent opens under the glass roses.

quests.name: The Remembered Bed
quests.description: The rememberer says the garden keeps a bed beneath the roses. Plant the memory rose, go down, and bring back the bloom.
quests.complete: The rememberer sets the bloom among the roots. The bed remembers another year.

quests.name: The First Bed
quests.description: The root keeper wants the first seed from the oldest bed. Talk to the keeper, walk east, and bring the seed back.
quests.complete: The keeper sets the seed in the archive. The first bed is named again.
